_notes.purpose: Curated Creative Commons video sources for AVOD-Lab. All entries must be CC BY or CC0. Run `python scripts/fetch_cc_videos.py --verify-only` to confirm licenses before downloading.
_notes.how_to_run: python scripts/fetch_cc_videos.py  →  downloads all, trims to 15 min, writes static/content/<id>.mp4
_notes.how_to_add: Add an object to 'videos'. 'url' accepts any yt-dlp-supported URL (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.). After running --verify-only, paste the printed catalogue snippet into config/experiment.json.
_notes.finding_more: YouTube: search, then Filter → Type → Video, Features → Creative Commons. Vimeo CC search: https://vimeo.com/search?license=by. Blender Foundation channel: https://www.youtube.com/@BlenderFoundation — all short films are CC BY 3.0 or 4.0.
